description: OIDC Trust Allows an Overly Broad Subject Scope (Review)
rationale: A role trust policy appears to allow a federated OIDC principal with a broad StringLike sub scope or no subject restriction. This is a potential authorization-scope weakness. Some OIDC providers, including GitHub, reject missing or all-wildcard sub restrictions at policy creation; ambiguous policies are UNKNOWN.
remediation: Constrain OIDC trust to expected organization, repository, branch, environment, namespace or service account, and verify audience and provider-specific condition keys. For GitHub use repository-scoped sub conditions and protected environments.
